_about: Hand-curated Apollo 11 evaluation set for scripts/evaluate.py.
Ground truth is anchored on source_id + a distinctive text snippet, never
on chunk_id: chunk ids are DB-assigned and would silently shift on
Every must_contain snippet below was verified present in a real chunk
before it shipped. Matching is whitespace- and hyphen-insensitive (see
normalize() in scripts/evaluate.py) because the extracted PDF text
contains both split words ('land- ing') and run-together words
('Thepurposeof'). Snippets were also checked for specificity -- a vague
snippet like 'quarantine' matches 63 chunks and is useless as ground truth.
Note that documents 19710015566 and 19700008096 are two editions of the
same Apollo 11 Mission Report, so many facts legitimately appear in both.
